title: APT Paper Reproduction: Adaptive Pruning and Tuning
setup: Implemented complete APT methodology with adaptive adapters, outlier-aware salience scoring, and self-distillation. Includes baseline LoRA comparisons.
results: Successfully implemented APT training framework with reproduce.sh script for automated execution. Experiments configured for RoBERTa-base on SST2/MNLI with multiple sparsity levels.
notes: Core APT components: dynamic rank adjustment, exponential moving average salience (α=0.85), outlier detection (τ=4.0), task-specific distillation weights. Expected ~98% accuracy retention with 60% sparsity.
dataFiles: GLUE datasets (SST2, MNLI) loaded programmatically via HuggingFace
codeRepo: code/ directory with apt_adapter.py, train_apt.py, baseline_lora.py, reproduce.sh
